title: Comparing Options and Choosing
context: Choosing a phone, a course or a flat means comparing. You need comparatives, linking words for contrast, and clear language to explain your choice.
contextPersian: انتخاب یک گوشی، یک دوره یا یک خانه یعنی مقایسه. به صفت‌های تفضیلی، کلمه‌های ربط برای تضاد و زبان روشن برای توضیح انتخابت نیاز داری.

roleplay.aiRole: A friend who is choosing between two courses
roleplay.objective: Compare two courses, explain your preference and recommend one
roleplay.context: Your friend cannot decide between a cheaper online course and a more expensive classroom course. Compare them, say what you prefer and why, and give a recommendation.
roleplay.opening: I can't decide: the online course is cheaper, but the classroom one has a teacher. What do you think?
